name: Password Generator
description: Generate strong, random passwords using your browser's cryptographically secure random number generator — nothing is transmitted or stored.

faq.question: How random is the password this generates?
faq.answer: Passwords are generated using the Web Crypto API's crypto.getRandomValues(), a cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator built into your browser — the same class of randomness used for cryptographic keys, not Math.random(), which is not safe for this purpose. Character selection uses rejection sampling to avoid modulo bias.

faq.question: Are generated passwords sent anywhere or logged?
faq.answer: No. Generation happens entirely in your browser; ToolHub has no backend to send a password to, and nothing is written to storage or logged.

faq.question: Why does it guarantee at least one character from each selected category?
faq.answer: Many account systems require a mix of character types. This generator seeds one character from every category you've enabled, then fills the rest of the length from the combined pool and shuffles — so the requirement is met without making the arrangement predictable.
